subject: Final cutover planning — confirm owners, fallback policy & timing

Subject: Final cutover planning — confirm owners, fallback policy & timing

Hi Alex —

Quick recap from our pre-prod run: we need one final cross-functional planning call to lock the cutover window, confirm owners for each step, and agree on the fallback plan if anything degrades. To keep this short, suggested agenda (30–45m):

- 10m: Rollout timeline & owner walk-through (AE + SE + Customer Eng)
- 10m: Fallback/rollback policy and success criteria (SE + Infra)
- 10m: Procurement / billing & access sign-offs (Procurement)
- 10m: Security checklist & monitoring handoff (Security)
- 5m: Action items + calendar invites

Proposed slots (PST):
1) Wed Aug 11 — 11:00–11:45am
2) Thu Aug 12 — 8:30–9:15am
3) Fri Aug 13 — 10:00–10:45am

I've attached the current rollout_playbook_v2.pdf and a cutover checklist. If none of those work, you can pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/jasmine-final-cutover

Please loop in procurement/security owners if they should be on the call. I can extend to 60 minutes if needed.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai] | +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: rollout_playbook_v2.pdf, cutover_checklist_v1.xlsx

Thanks Jasmine —

Appreciate the agenda. Carlos (our platform lead) is on copy. Two quick notes:

- Procurement needs to review the billing/commit section and will want to sit in for that part (they may only need 10 minutes).
- Security wants to join for the monitoring & log access discussion but prefers a later slot (EST morning works best for them).

From our side, Thu Aug 12 8:30am PST (11:30am EST) would be OK, but Procurement currently has a contract review at 11:00am EST — I can check and confirm. If we can move to 11:00am EST exactly, that would be ideal for Security and Procurement to join in sequence.

Can you do Thu Aug 12 at 11:00am EST?

— Alex

Hi Alex —

Yes — Thu Aug 12 at 11:00am EST (8:00am PST) is doable on our side. We'll plan for a 60 minute session to give Procurement and Security time. Proposed final agenda (60m):

- 00–10m: Rollout timeline & responsibilities (Jasmine / Carlos)
- 10–25m: Cutover steps & technical owners (Dev Patel)
- 25–40m: Fallback / rollback criteria + runbook review (Dev + Carlos)
- 40–50m: Procurement sign-off & billing transition (Procurement rep)
- 50–60m: Security access, monitoring, and post-cutover checks (Security rep)

If you confirm, I'll send a calendar invite and include these attachments: rollout_playbook_v2.pdf, cutover_checklist_v1.xlsx and the calendar_inv.ics.

Also tagging Dev/Monica — please add one-line owners below (who's doing DB failover, who's monitoring, who's responsible for rollback decision).

Thanks —
Jasmine
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 06:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final cutover planning — confirm owners, fallback policy & timing

Jasmine / Monica — quick internal note (will present on the call):

- DB failover: Marcus Lin (on-call infra) — responsible for initiating failover if latency > 2s for 5m during cutover.
- KV cache rollback: Monica will trigger cache invalidation and fallback to S3-backed responses if needed.
- Model fallback: SE will switch traffic to the quantized-compatible variant (model-v2-q4) and set routing to 30% step-down over 15m.
- Monitoring owner: Carlos (Finova) + Dev (Redwood) will jointly watch token-level latency and error spikes.
- Rollback decision: Monica (Redwood CS) + Alex (Finova Eng Director) jointly sign off.

I'll prepare a 1-slide runbook summary for the call.

- Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — confirmed. I've added Jamie Cole (Procurement) and the security alias (security-team@finova.com).

One ask for the agenda: procurement would like to review the monthly overage thresholds and the plan for short-term burst capacity in the first 48 hours post-cutover. Security also requested that we include a short discussion of audit log retention and KMS integration (5m).

We're set for Thu Aug 12, 11:00am EST / 8:00am PST. See you then.

— Alex

Alex / Team —

Calendar invite sent for Thu Aug 12, 11:00am EST (calendar_inv.ics attached). Apologies — calendar systems sometimes normalize to the invite timezone; please trust the time in the body above.

Attached: rollout_playbook_v2.pdf, cutover_checklist_v1.xlsx.

Final owners and quick run-of-show:
- Jasmine (Redwood AE) — meeting chair / business sign-off
- Dev Patel (Redwood SE) — technical lead / rollback executor
- Marcus Lin (Finova infra) — DB failover owner
- Monica Patel (Redwood CS) — cache/monitoring and rollback co-owner
- Carlos Mendez (Finova) — monitoring & post-cutover validation
- Jamie Cole (Finova Procurement) — billing & overage guardrails
- Security alias (Finova) — audit logs + KMS integration verification

Fallback / rollback summary (one liner to be executed if thresholds breached):
- If token latency > 2s for persistent 5 minutes OR error rate > 2% over a 5 minute window, SE initiates model-v2-q4 rollback and DB failover is triggered by Marcus. Monica will initiate cache fallback. Decision to continue or fully rollback will be jointly made by Monica + Alex within the next 30 minutes post-action.

Action items before call:
- Alex: confirm Marcus can present DB failover (done)
- Jamie: bring the overage/burst thresholds to the call
- Security: prepare 1 slide on audit and KMS access
- Dev: 1-slide runbook + quick dashboard link (if possible)
